notes: policy_seed applies to the baseline only; PPO ignores it.

pairingSemantics: Matched and verified before a result is returned: initial profile, environment seed, scenario, horizon, reward configuration and transition-data hash. Because the environment seed is shared, the simulator draws the same sequence of per-step transition seeds by step index. A transition seed only seeds the random draw among the candidate transitions of the selected action in the current state. Those candidate sets depend on the action and state, so equal seeds do not guarantee identical transition outcomes, and trajectories can diverge once the strategies choose different actions. PPO is deterministic and ignores the policy seed; the baseline uses it for tie-breaking among susceptible actions.

transitionSeedSchedule.meaning: Equal transition seeds only seed the random draw among the selected action's candidate transitions in the current state; they do not make the outcomes equal.

cumulativeResistanceBurden.definition: Negative of the simulator's cumulative reward (ml.src.matched_policy_evaluation._episode_burden): sum over steps of resistant_count_after / 7, with an all-resistant state charged for the remaining horizon. Lower means less simulated resistance burden; it is not a clinical outcome.
cumulativeResistanceBurden.unit: resistant-antibiotic burden normalized by 7 antibiotics; simulated, lower is less burden
cumulativeResistanceBurden.aggregation: Negated cumulative reward: the negated sum of step rewards plus the negated terminal adjustment, which is -horizon when the episode starts in the all-resistant terminal state and 0 otherwise (so a zero-step episode that starts all-resistant has burden equal to the horizon)

cumulativeReward.definition: Sum of simulator step rewards plus any terminal adjustment (ml.src.metrics).
cumulativeReward.aggregation: Sum of step rewards plus the terminal adjustment, which is -horizon when the episode starts in the all-resistant terminal state and 0 otherwise

treatmentSteps.definition: Number of actions taken before the episode ended.
treatmentSteps.aggregation: Number of actions taken before the episode ended

initialResistantCount.definition: Resistant antibiotics in the initial profile.
initialResistantCount.aggregation: Value at the start of the episode; not accumulated

finalResistantCount.definition: Resistant antibiotics in the final profile.
finalResistantCount.aggregation: Value at the end of the episode; not accumulated

finalSusceptibleCount.definition: Susceptible antibiotics in the final profile (ml.src.metrics future_effective_antibiotics).
finalSusceptibleCount.aggregation: Value at the end of the episode; not accumulated

changeInSusceptibleCount.definition: final_susceptible_count minus the initial susceptible count.
changeInSusceptibleCount.aggregation: Final susceptible count minus initial susceptible count

resistanceEmergenceEvents.definition: Steps after which the resistant count increased (ml.src.metrics).
resistanceEmergenceEvents.aggregation: Number of steps after which the resistant count increased

resistanceEmergenceRate.definition: resistance_emergence_events / treatment_steps; null when there are no steps.
resistanceEmergenceRate.unit: proportion of steps in [0, 1]; not a percentage
resistanceEmergenceRate.aggregation: resistance_emergence_events divided by treatment_steps; null when there are no steps

susceptibleActionRate.definition: Fraction of steps whose selected drug was susceptible in the simulator (ml.src.metrics treatment_effectiveness_rate). The susceptible-only mask makes this 1.0 for both strategies, and it is not clinical efficacy; null when there are no steps.
susceptibleActionRate.unit: proportion of steps in [0, 1]; not a percentage
susceptibleActionRate.aggregation: Steps whose selected drug was susceptible in the simulator divided by treatment_steps; null when there are no steps

unsupportedStepCount.definition: Steps with transition_status unsupported_no_candidate: the simulator had no candidate transition and left the profile unchanged.
unsupportedStepCount.aggregation: Number of steps with transition_status unsupported_no_candidate

cumulativeAntibioticExposure.definition: Number of antibiotic administrations (one per step).
cumulativeAntibioticExposure.aggregation: One per step, so it equals treatment_steps

singleRunCaveat: One paired trajectory is a single stochastic sample. It does not show that either strategy is better, and it is not clinical evidence.
disclaimer: Simulation output only. It is not clinical advice, a validated treatment recommendation, or a statement about clinical efficacy.
